speaker: caller
text: Hi, I'm Rachel from an online marketing agency. You applied for our part-time job, right?

speaker: receiver
text: Oh, maybe. What's the job about?

speaker: caller
text: You just like and review products on shopping sites from home. You can earn eighty to two hundred dollars a day.

speaker: receiver
text: That sounds easy. Is there a catch?

speaker: caller
text: No catch. I already added three tasks to your account, and your first commission is waiting.

speaker: caller
text: Good. To withdraw your commission, the system needs you to complete one merchant task first.

speaker: caller
text: You top up five hundred dollars to the merchant account, and you get it back with thirty percent commission.

speaker: receiver

text: The task expires in twenty minutes, so please transfer now or you will lose everything you earned today.
